content: अप्रमाद {%a.%} Careful, vigilant, cautious, steady. .{@-दः@} Care, attention, vigilance. .{@-दम्@} {%ind.%} Carefully, attentively, uninterruptedly. .{@-ता@} The state of being cautious; शौचाक्रोधाप्रमादता <ls>Y. 3. 313</ls>. .{@-दिन्@} {%a.%} careful; तस्मै मां ब्रूहि विप्राय निधिपायाप्रमादिने <ls>Ms. 2. 115</ls>.
